story_sequence.text: QA evo-deep reads PRD, user-story, test-case, QA scorecard, and AC closure before producing a ready report.
Every ready finding includes non-empty `affected_ac_ids` and non-empty `current_evidence_refs`.
Empty skeleton findings fail closed unless represented as blocked admissions with explicit source gaps and route recommendations.
Skill Eval Kit validates route decision, boundary preservation, and source anchoring through replay traces instead of schema-only checks.
QA scorecard records whether each deep finding was absorbed, deferred, blocked, or not applicable.
Release readiness treats only formally absorbed deep findings as release supplement input and keeps advisory-only or blocked findings out of pass evidence.
QA evo-deep and Skill Eval outputs cannot claim PRD, user-story, test-case, QA verdict, release verdict, gate verdict, or freeze authority.
